promotion_note: PROMOTED 2026-08-03 (nyiso-118). NYISO keeper -> 2026-08-03-nyiso-118-seny-span (bundle results/calibration/nyiso118_seny_span). Determination CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS, C3c the sole ledgered caveat, UNCHANGED. WHAT THIS PROMOTION DOES: it arms nyiso_ordc_measured_step_span, a CONSTRUCTION-CONSISTENCY FIX and not a lever. When nyiso_dynamic_reserve_requirements enforces the MEASURED hourly requirement on the reserve balance row -- which it already did on the incumbent keeper -- the ORDC demand curve priced against that row was still being built off the STATIC published MW. The flag scales each dynamic family's width vector by requirement[t] / requirement_static, restoring the identity TOTAL STEP WIDTH == THE HOUR'S REQUIREMENT. ONE config delta, ZERO free parameters: the DOF ledger goes 31 -> 32 entries with n_residual UNCHANGED at 6, because the scale factor is the ratio of two ALREADY-COMMITTED MEASURED INPUTS and the published RCPF penalties are requirement-INDEPENDENT (measured unchanged by the flag) -- there is nothing in the mechanism to tune. The defect is measured, not inferred: SENY's total step width differed from its own requirement in 6239 / 6249 / 6231 hours of 2023/24/25 before the flag and 0 / 0 / 0 after. PROMOTION RESTS ON RULE 1 [R-STRUCT] / RULE 14 [R-ACCURATE], NOT ON GATE MOVEMENT, AND THE RESIDUAL DELIBERATELY DID NOT MOVE: all 18 scored numeric fields are EQUAL to the same-HEAD control's, every criterion verdict is identical, and the grade summary (9 scored / 8 target / 1 ledgered / 0 fails) and C1 headline (all 14/14, free 10/10) are unchanged. Rule 1 is explicit that a structurally-correct mechanism is never rejected or reverted because the residual did not move; the static 1,300 MW span was an ESTIMATE leaking into a curve whose balance row is measured, which is exactly what rule 14 forbids keeping once the accurate input is in hand. GATES -- ALL SIX PASS AND NO KILL FIRES, against a same-HEAD zero-delta control (2026-08-03-nyiso-118-control-zerodelta), MANDATORY rather than optional because FINDING-nyiso114 section 2 measured that a P0-run-pattern keeper does not re-solve to byte-identity once main moves. G1 the construction identity is restored (above). G2a every family's requirement_mw -- the balance-row RHS, the one pure INPUT in the sidecar -- float32-EXACTLY identical between arms in all three years, asserted as np.array_equal rather than against a 1e-6 MW tolerance the float32 dtype cannot represent (nyiso-116). G2b LI no-double-apply (below). G2c an independent instrument that never touches the parquet: the solve log's ORDC step count is UNCHANGED at 59 / 59 / 59 in both arms -- the flag re-spans widths and adds or removes NO steps -- committed as each bundle's ordc_steps.log. G3 (held + shortfall >= requirement everywhere), G4 (zero unserved-energy slack and zero dump in BOTH arms, all years), G5 (2023-2025 in one bundle per arm; holdout freeze ACTIVE and untouched), G6 (both arms scored, determinations identical) all PASS. K-A..K-E do not fire. THE ONE LIVE COUPLING WAS SETTLED EX ANTE, ON CONSTRUCTION, BEFORE THE SOLVE. The LI locational ladder (nyiso_li_locational_reserve, armed on the keeper) already applies this SAME span translation family-scoped and unconditionally to li_30min_total, deliberately without flipping the global flag -- so arming it globally could have DOUBLE-APPLIED. scripts/probes/_nyiso118_span_construction_probe.py builds the NYISO ReserveDesign TWICE at one HEAD and diffs every family's requirement, ordc_penalties and ordc_step_widths, with NO LP and NO dual -- because dual and held_mw are SOLVED co-optimization outputs whose byte-identity can only pass when the mechanism does nothing (the nyiso-115 G2 error). li_30min_total is byte-identical between arms in ALL THREE vectors, in all three years: K-A did not fire. The guard's `or` is boolean, not additive, and LI's family-scoped entry has already normalized its widths. TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE RECORD, both MEASURED rather than assumed. (1) THE BLAST RADIUS IS THREE FAMILIES, NOT ONE: _nyiso_design's docstring claimed the flag is a no-op for NYCA, East and NYC; that is FALSE for NYC, whose measured requirement dips BELOW its static base in 185/227/120 hours. The docstring was corrected against the probe in the same session. (2) BUT NYC IS RE-REPRESENTED, NOT RE-PRICED, so the rule-23 [R-FROZEN-DERIVE] freeze on the NYC curve is NOT disturbed: shortfall is bounded above by the hour's requirement (held >= 0), so width beyond it is unreachable padding, and under the frozen nyiso_nyc_rcpf_step_curve that family is a SINGLE FLAT BAND at the published $25 RCPF -- trimming padding off a flat band cannot move a price. The reachable price function is pointwise IDENTICAL (max |dprice| $0.000 in every year, both NYC families), so K-B did not fire. That three-way split -- SENY re-priced, NYC re-represented, LI untouched -- is also what demonstrates the construction instrument HAS DISCRIMINATING POWER: it is not a gate that can only pass by doing nothing. THE PARTIAL WAS PRE-REGISTERED AS SUCH (PREREG section 4) AND IT HELD -- THIS DOES NOT CLOSE THE S-OVER FINDING AND IS NOT REPORTED AS DOING SO. The flag re-spans WIDTHS only. SENY's penalty vector is measured UNCHANGED and its FIRST RUNG IS STILL $62.50, which already sits above the ENTIRE measured envelope ($23.92 / $30.37 / $40.00 in 2023/24/25, with 52 hours of 2025 at exactly the published ASM items-2/12 $40 increment and ZERO hours above it in any year). So arming this flag ALONE CANNOT bring SENY inside the measured envelope. The remaining defect -- the published curve is a $500 base PLUS a $40 increment while the model carries only the base as a critical_mw = 0 ramp -- is a SECOND mechanism requiring its own pre-registration and its own arm (rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH]); nothing was introduced, changed or fitted for it here. MEASURED EFFECT, reported precisely: 2023 and 2024 are BIT-IDENTICAL between arms; only 2025 moves, and it moves DOWNWARD -- SENY's max dual 125.00 -> 87.07, the shallower ramp and the pre-registered direction. The effect is small because SENY BINDS IN ALMOST NO HOURS (2/0/8 in the control), NOT because the curve barely changed: its reachable price differs in roughly 6,100 hours per year, but a demand curve can only price where there is a shortfall. The NYC pair gains one binding hour each in 2025 with its own curve provably unchanged -- that is co-optimization general equilibrium propagating through held reserve, which is precisely why the scope kill was written on CONSTRUCTION and the duals were REPORTED rather than gated. C3c IS UNCHANGED and that null was PRE-REGISTERED (PREREG section 5), not discovered afterwards: C3c is closed as a lever lane with an exhausted queue, and its re-open condition remains a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT under its own owner charter, never a mechanism-flag lever. This does NOT reach nyiso-110's everyday-reserve-formation gap and is NOT reported as closing it. Evidence: results/calibration/PREREG-nyiso118-seny-span-2026-08-03.md, FINDING-nyiso118-seny-span-2026-08-03.md, nyiso118_gate_scores.json, nyiso118_span_construction_probe.json.

frontier.note: FRONTIER DECLARED + DETERMINATION MOVED NOT-YET -> CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS (owner decision, session nyiso-104: 'I am comfortable with taking c3c as a caveat and calling NYISO calibrated with caveats if we've exhausted options to address scarcity tail'). C3c was the SOLE blocker and every other criterion already PASSED; it is now carried as ONE ledgered caveat (budget 3) via the exceptions block of the keeper's calibration_attestation.json, generated by scripts/gen_nyiso100_attestation.py (the GENERATOR is the source of truth — editing only the emitted JSON is reverted by the next run). THE CAVEAT IS NOT A CLAIM THAT THE BENCHMARK IS WRONG: the measured RT tail is real (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300) and the model under-produces it. It records an EXHAUSTED lever queue on a diagnosed structural limitation of the five-zone representation — items 1/1b refused ex-ante on identification (nyiso-94/95), item 5 inert ex-ante (nyiso-93), items 2/3 closed and tested (nyiso-96), the last surviving candidate SCUC load-pocket security commitment + BPCG closed ex-ante on CONTENT not merely access (nyiso-97), import shape refused as an attributed C3c symptom with the seam exonerated (nyiso-99), G-J locality refused ex-ante for want of a representable boundary (nyiso-101). The one nominally-open item (nyiso_iroquois_winter_spread) is blocked on a joint SUMMER scarcity lever, and summer is exactly what is exhausted — nyiso-92 dated the actual RT tail as summer (2025 Jun 23-25 alone = 18 of 42 h; the Jan-2024 storm produced ZERO >$300 hours), capping the winter-fuel lane at ~4-5 h/yr. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] is why this is a ledger entry and not a mechanism: every remaining way to lift the tail is fitted to the tail residual. RE-OPEN CONDITION, satisfiable: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT makes the sub-zonal load pocket representable — its own owner charter (the ERCOT West/Panhandle class, CLOSED), never a mechanism-flag lever. KEEPER UNCHANGED (2026-07-30-nyiso-100-silretire) and NO SOLVE RAN — this is a scorer-side reclassification on the committed bundle. Holdout: NYISO re-declared in the `complete` (VALIDATION-tier) block of calibration-complete.json — 2022 + the 2018/2020/2021 ladder, NOT training; it is deliberately ABSENT from the new `final` (locked-test) block, so 2019 / H1-2026 stay blocked. The ACTIVE holdout spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve regardless, so nothing is spendable until the owner lifts it. Evidence: docs/FINDING-nyiso104-c3c-frontier-and-tiered-holdout-2026-07-31.md.
frontier.amendment_note: THE C3c FRONTIER DECLARATION STANDS, AND ITS PREMISE IS RESTORED. nyiso-108's amendment recorded that the nyiso-104b premise - C3c is the SOLE blocker and every other criterion PASSES - had lapsed, because the hydro input repair exposed a real 2023 fossil over-pricing that failed C3a. nyiso-109 closed that defect on measured grounds (the gas-offer margin anchor resolved per zone, zero free parameters), so C3a PASSES in all three years and C3c is once again the SOLE remaining miss, carried as ONE ledgered caveat. NYISO's determination is CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS. C3c itself is UNCHANGED across this A/B (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300 in both arms), so no C3c evidence moved, the exhausted-queue finding is untouched, no new caveat slot is spent, and the re-open condition is unchanged: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT under its own owner charter, never a mechanism-flag lever. WHAT IS EXPLICITLY *NOT* RESTORED IS THE 'options exhausted' READING. nyiso-109 measured a second, non-C3c, structurally real and still-open defect: the model's price DISTRIBUTION is compressed in all three years - it reproduces only 69/49/45 % of the measured trough->peak swing, and after this arm the peak half remains under-priced (C3a 2025 -9.64 %, inside the band but nearer its edge). That defect passes every current gate, so it is not a blocker; it is an open structural item with no lever chartered yet, and it is the named successor lane. Holdout unaffected: NYISO keeps `complete`, stays ABSENT from `final`, and the ACTIVE spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve.
